Services.intro: From complete interior concepts to focused design consultations, each service offers a considered approach to a different stage of your project.

interiorDesign.title: Interior Design
interiorDesign.short: Complete interior concepts, from spatial planning to the finest details.
interiorDesign.description: A comprehensive design concept for a room or an entire home. From spatial organisation and visual direction to furniture, materials and lighting, each element is developed as part of a cohesive interior. The result is a clear design direction shaped by the space and the way it will be lived in.

spacePlanning.title: Space Planning
spacePlanning.short: Intelligent layouts that make the most of every space.
spacePlanning.description: A focused exploration of how a space can work better. Through thoughtful zoning, circulation and furniture placement, WONDER develops layout solutions that improve everyday function while respecting the proportions and character of the interior.

furnitureMaterials.title: Furniture & Materials
furnitureMaterials.short: Considered selections of furniture, finishes and lighting.
furnitureMaterials.description: For spaces where the layout is already established, WONDER brings together furniture, materials, finishes and decorative lighting into a consistent visual direction. The focus is on creating balance, texture and character through carefully considered combinations.

designSupport.title: Design Support
designSupport.short: Focused design guidance for important decisions.
designSupport.description: Targeted design consultations for projects already taking shape. Whether reviewing a layout, considering material options or resolving a particular design challenge, WONDER provides an independent perspective and practical recommendations to help move the project forward with confidence.

Studio.lead: Contemporary interiors shaped by thoughtful composition, tactile materials and a strong sense of character.
Studio.paragraph1: WONDER is an independent interior design studio with a distinct point of view. The approach is guided by proportion, natural light and the relationship between objects and space.
Studio.paragraph2: Rather than following trends or repeating formulas, WONDER explores the individual potential of each space through a consistent design sensibility — creating interiors that feel both distinctive and personal.

InteriorStudies.sectionRight: A STUDY IN SPACE, LIGHT & MATERIAL
InteriorStudies.intro: One point of view does not mean one look. We shape colour, material and atmosphere around the person, the place and the way the space should feel.

Approach.intro: A considered process, from understanding the space and defining its direction to developing the details that bring the design together.

discover.title: Discover
discover.body: Understanding the space, its possibilities, the project brief and what matters most.

define.title: Define
define.body: Establishing the spatial concept, key priorities and a clear visual direction.

develop.title: Develop
develop.body: Bringing together materials, furniture, lighting and details into a coherent design.

refine.title: Refine
refine.body: Reviewing decisions, making final adjustments and preparing the agreed design materials.

Philosophy.lead: An interior can be beautiful at first glance and still have more to reveal. A change in light, an unexpected pairing, a detail discovered over time — these are the moments that give a space depth.
Philosophy.description: For WONDER, curiosity is not about adding more. It is about seeing more: finding the possibilities already present in a room and bringing them into focus with clarity and restraint.
Philosophy.imageAlt: Sunlit dining room with sculptural leather chairs, a large paper lantern and abstract artwork

Materials.lead: A room is experienced through the details as much as the whole.
Materials.description: The warmth of timber, the weight of stone, the way light meets a surface. We bring furniture, finishes and textures together so every choice contributes to a coherent interior.
